cases.title: Brown Eyed Girl

setup.tuning_status: Project open-chord practice proposal; explicit support exists in the older separate Stanley arrangement, which was not reopened in this pass

source_observations: Four-chord accompaniment and optional intro/lead work are separate learning tasks.
The linked rhythm lesson omits an attack on count 3 while the hand continues its eighth-note motion.
cases.proposed_rhythm_note: Begin with steady strokes, then practise a ringing tie across an omitted attack. Keep the hand moving. This is a teacher-supported accompaniment exercise; its contacts are not an exact-upload strum transcription.
cases.proposed_review_note: Keep G/C/D/Em as source-supported practice shapes, inspect Em contrast and original-recording tempo independently, and leave lead/intro work optional. A skipped attack lets the prior sound ring; it is not a deliberate mute.
next_checks: Compare detected pulse periods to individual attacks without treating every transient as a beat.
Check Em versus major alternatives and selected-upload pitch before attaching playable setup.
Do not replace the existing pulse estimate using another arrangement's tempo.

cases.title: Seven Nation Army

setup.tuning_status: Teacher explicitly distinguishes the standard adaptation from original Open A

source_observations: The main riff is foundational; the chorus adds a power-chord variation.
The lesson uses standard tuning and a no-slide solo adaptation; the teacher identifies original Open A/slide playing separately.
cases.proposed_rhythm_note: Practise the single-note groove and clean muting first. Introduce the power-chord variation as a separate task. A continuous chord strumming drill is accompaniment practice, not the main riff.
cases.proposed_review_note: Keep standard-tuning adaptation separate from original Open A. Major/minor labels over a monophonic riff do not establish played chord grips, and the Open A setup requires string-specific mapping.
next_checks: Inspect note/attack repetition separately from harmonic transitions.
Check riff versus fuller accompaniment contrasts without interpreting detector label changes as riff-note truth.
Do not promote this recording into the open-chord strumming path using its label count.

cases.title: Creep

setup.tuning_status: Consistent with teacher fret/root-six descriptions; not an explicit newly checked tuning sentence

source_observations: The four main barre grips include B major and C minor.
Verse picking varies; chorus parts become fuller and the ending chorus extends. Acoustic sus4 embellishments belong to a separate variant.
cases.proposed_rhythm_note: Begin with controlled chord changes, then a flexible verse arpeggio and fuller chorus attack. Do not impose one fixed picking pattern across the recording.
cases.proposed_review_note: Preserve B major and C minor in main-chord mode; key-only substitution would erase the defining quality contrast. Treat acoustic sus4 additions and the optional chorus octave melody as separate choices.
next_checks: Compare B/Bm and C/Cm acoustic support without forcing either result from key.
Inspect repeated chord-duration differences and section dynamics independently.
Keep physical barre difficulty separate from the four-label vocabulary count.

cases.title: The House Of The Rising Sun

setup.tuning_status: Project standard open-grip proposal; not an explicit newly checked tuning sentence

source_observations: The teacher describes 6/8, a small-F option, picked/raked arpeggios and a distinct Am/Dm outro.
Richter explicitly specifies no capo and offers optional E7 and fingerstyle choices.
cases.proposed_rhythm_note: Start with six evenly spaced eighth-note counts grouped 3+3, then a root-led picked/raked arpeggio. Fingerstyle is an optional adaptation. Counts are a practice convention until the selected recording's pulse phase is checked.
cases.proposed_review_note: Retain D major and E major in the A-minor teaching palette, add the distinct Dm outro and a small-F choice. Inspect shorter changes within outro phrases. Do not infer numbered bars from a global pulse estimate.
next_checks: Test three-subdivision/two-pulse grouping as a hypothesis, including half/double-tempo alternatives.
Inspect Am/Dm outro contrast and independently determine within-bar change placement.
Keep recorded flat-pick technique separate from a fingerstyle learning adaptation.

cases.proposed_rhythm_note: Keep a continuous subdivision motion while deciding which passes contact the strings. Practise verse, pre-chorus and chorus separately. The current generic syncopated drill is a preparatory exercise, not a complete recorded strum pattern.
cases.proposed_review_note: Preserve capo-2 played shapes separately from sounding labels. Offer shared-finger richer grips as a project practice option; simplifying to main chords loses the suspended/add-note colour. Section extents and local meter remain unverified.
next_checks: Compare native sounding labels with richer anchored-grip alternatives without overwriting the raw charts.
Inspect verse variations and shorter passing changes separately from long harmonic holds.
Do not carry prior 4/4-to-2/4 wording as newly confirmed evidence: neither page rechecked here explicitly establishes those meter changes.
